notes: OpenRouter decisions-modality listings (14 ids; 12 stored here, two aliases of Jev and the :free Span-01 Lite route share rows): per-token prompt prices converted from the listing "pricing" strings (USD per token x 1,000,000); completion is always $0 (output free). OpenRouter is a router: prices can differ from the model vendor price (Perplexity $0.04 vs $0.02 direct). Default /api/v1/models hides decision models; they appear with ?output_modalities=decisions. Request volume and p50 latency are in the performance docs. Cache fields: cache_read_per_m is filled only where the listing prints an input_cache_read value (OpenAI Decisions Luna $0, Liquid d1 $0.04, Solar Decide $0.05; cache_rates_status "published"). Every other cache field is null with status "not_published": the listing has no cache field for it. No cache rate is inferred from the prompt price. 2026-11-26 re-read (listing now holds 44 ids): 48 figures compared across the 12 stored rows. Changed: clef-flash prompt $0.09 -> $0.038/M (context 65536 -> 24576), clef prompt $0.24 -> $0.192/M (context 65536 -> 65537), luna input_cache_write now printed $0 (cache_write_per_m null -> 0.0, status published). Retired (gone from the listing; pages are tombstones with no provider pricing): pplx-decider-v1-27b, liquid-d1, mercury-decide. 34 newer ids at the source, not added.
